newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Commercial extends note offer period.
newsitem.headline: Asia Commercial extends note offer period.

text.p: Asia Commercial Holdings Ltd on Friday said it postponed the closing of the acceptance period for the exchange of notes to noon, January 24, from noon, January 23.

It said in a statement the rate of acceptance of the offer to exchange notes was 79.65 percent of the value of notes held, less than the minimum of 80 percent which had been a condition for the note exchange.
It said it decided to postpone the closing even though the condition "may be waived by subscribers at their sole discretion".

The company has been seeking the approval of banks and convertible noteholders for its capital and debt restructuring agreement. It said the last of 14 banks had signed a bank compromise agreement on January 23 to approve the plan.

Under the restructuring proposal, Pacific Apex International Ltd, Leung Chung-Ping and Galmare Investment Ltd agreed to subscribe for a total of 112.5 million shares of HK$1.00 each, representing about 40.2 percent of the restructured share capital of the company, the company said earlier.
Dealing in Asia Commercial shares remained suspended.
